functions.name: tbapi_version
functions.description: Returns the library version string for the Telegram Bot API C interface. Typical usage is to query and display or log the version at startup or for diagnostics. No parameters are required. Details about the ownership and lifetime of the returned string are not documented in the header; it is likely a static, read-only string, but this is not guaranteed.
requirements: No arguments are accepted; call as tbapi_version().
The returned pointer is const; the caller must not modify the pointed-to character data.
Ownership of the returned pointer is unspecified; do not attempt to free it unless explicitly documented elsewhere.
The lifetime and thread-safety of the returned pointer are unspecified; if used across threads or stored, ensure it remains valid per external documentation.
Because nullability is unspecified, callers should defensively check for a NULL return before dereferencing.
